title: Moldovan table tennis makes history in Sarajevo
excerpt: For the first time, Moldova has a Balkan champion team in men's senior table tennis: Vladislav Ursu, Andrei Puțuntica and Cezar Cozmolici won the title in Sarajevo.
body_html:
For the first time ever, the Republic of Moldova has a Balkan champion team in table tennis, in the men's senior category. The result came at the final tournament in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina, where our team was in outstanding form from the first match to the last.

The trophy carries the signature of three players: Vladislav Ursu, Andrei Puțuntica and Cezar Cozmolici, supported at this competition by national team coach Veniamin Dubrovin.

Moldova got past its first two opponents without breaking a sweat:

Against North Macedonia the score was emphatic: 3:0

The same result against Kosovo: 3:0

In the semi-final Romania were beaten 3:1, sending Moldova into the grand final

The last obstacle was Serbia, a formidable opponent who took the tie all the way to the limit. The final score, 3:2 to Moldova, says everything about how hard-fought it was: the two teams stayed level right up to the fifth and deciding match of the final.

No Moldovan men's senior team had ever before stood on the top step of the podium at a Balkan Championship. The title won in Sarajevo is therefore a landmark moment for the federation and for Moldovan sport as a whole.

Congratulations to Vladislav Ursu, Andrei Puțuntica and Cezar Cozmolici, and to coach Veniamin Dubrovin, on this historic result!

Congratulations, boys - you've made history!
